_about: A copy-me file for a new townsfolk (a named walk-in who comes and goes; see Townsfolk). Copy it to <id>.json (files starting with _ are skipped), fill it in, and delete the _ notes you don't need. Anything left empty falls back to the generic lines in data/service.json "townsfolk".
name: Rosie
_species: One of data/species.json. They look like their own "model", or their species' (songbird, rabbit, cow, deer, pig, terrier, wolf have one). Without either they're a plain body in "color", or their species' color.
_model: Optional: their own look, like a regular's: { "path": "res://design/characters/...glb", "height": 1.0 }. Leave it out to use their species' model.
_color: Optional: their own tint for the placeholder body, e.g. "#e9c4d4".
personality: One line to write their lines from.
_resident: true: lives here for good (never moves away). Leave it false and they come and go: in town for a few weeks, then away a while (data/service.json "semi_regulars").
_favorites: Dish and drink ids (design/menu/). They order these most of the time once they're on the menu.
_seating: Not used yet (seating types are still to come). E.g. "window", "booth", "bar".
_pairs: Not used yet (pair visits are still to come). The ids of townsfolk they sometimes come in with. List each pair in both files.
_lines: Lists of lines for each step of a visit, one picked at random. {dish} and {drink} fill in; {chef} is the name of the chef they're talking to, and a line with {chef} is only said once they've met that chef (been served by them before). Steps: host_stand, seated, drink_order, drink_served, wrong_drink, food_order, served (or served_perfect / served_great / served_okay / served_burnt), bill, farewell (as they pay). "eating" is one bubble per tier: { "perfect": ..., "great": ..., "okay": ..., "burnt": ... }. "seasonal" has the same steps for "spring", "summer", "autumn" or "winter": in that season they're said instead, half the time.
_phone: Optional: they also phone in delivery orders (see PhoneCalls). usual_order is a dish id; night_only callers only ring at night. Lines are { part: greeting | order | chat, text, choices? } with [dish] filled in; a chat line's choices are { tone, text, reply }.
